gateSummaries.message: Verified 6-stage CI/CD DAG model parity, dual archive+binary SHA-256 scanner pins, GitLab full-history parity, Trivy 0.69.4 compromise denylist, and OWASP CICD-SEC-01..10 controls.
Scanned 217 Python modules with import-alias resolution (SAST-PY-01..03: zero dangerous sinks, dynamic SQL expressions, or unbounded httpx calls).
Verified all 33 MCP tool schemas across 11 servers enforce additionalProperties: False and zero model-supplied TIN/subject_ref on T1-T3 tools.
Verified 5 OpenTofu HCL modules for multi-line block syntax and Trivy parser compatibility.
Scanned 41 TypeScript and 5 JavaScript modules (SAST-FE-01..05: DOM-XSS, Trusted Types, CSP Level 3, Service Worker, and BFF process sinks).

Executed 10 live DAST probe suites across ASGI services, MCP gateway, Channel Gateway, and Node.js BFF servers (DAST-01..10: Host injection, ASVS headers, DoS caps, H-06 mode fuzzing, staff 403, ASI02/03 smuggling, MCP NUL-byte/rebinding, ASI01 injection, webhook HMAC, and BFF route gates).
